thread:
Asha Patel: Quick design ask — we need a micro-deck visual taxonomy + gated lead-flow swimlane for next week's webinar. Deliverables: hero slide, 3 micro tiles (latency / cost / reliability), social-ready images, and a lead-routing diagram (CTA -> landing -> SDR/AE mapping). Low-fi comps first pls.

Theo Rivers: +1. Also need social sizes: 1080x1080 and 1200x628. Can we get motion-ready layers?

Priya Menon: @Riley (design-ops) tagging you — timeline and brand checks? Need alt text and accessible color variants for localization (EN/FR/DE).

Riley (design-ops): I can take this. ETA for first comps: 48 hours. Need final copy for each tile and the explicit routing rules. Will follow brand guardrails. Please confirm primary brand blue and allowed accent palette.

Asha Patel: Copy draft below for tiles (feel free to tighten):
- Tile A: "Latency: p95 < 20ms"
- Tile B: "Unit cost: ~$0.10 / 1k tokens (typical)"
- Tile C: "Reliability: 99.9% SLA"
Landing CTA: /webinar/inference-econ/register (gated)
Routing rule (simple): if company_size > 500 -> enterprise SDR queue; else -> inbound SDR.

Theo Rivers: Also want two headline variants for A/B test: 1) "Reduce inference cost by ~30%" 2) "Make LLM latency predictable"

Priya Menon: Legal check: any wording we should avoid on pricing? @Legal Bot

Legal Bot: Quick legal note — avoid absolute guarantees on pricing and latency. Suggest softening: "typical" or "up to". Required privacy line for gated form: "By registering you agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference. Your data will be handled per https://redwood.com/privacy." No claims about exact $ amounts as commitments.

Riley (design-ops): Thanks — will mark those as "typical". Figma board I'll use: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef12345/microdeck-launch (I'll drop frames into the "marketing/launch" page). Specs I'll follow: hero 1920x1080, social 1080x1080 + 1200x628, tiles exported @2x PNG and SVG.

Riley (design-ops): Accessibility notes: headers 22pt semibold, body 14pt regular; color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text. Use brand blue #0A74FF as primary; alternate palette: #0A74FF (primary), #0B6FD8 (accent), #F4F7FB (bg). I'll provide dark-mode variants.

Asha Patel: Perfect. Also include a single-slide "lead routing matrix" that visualizes: CTA (gated/ungated) -> form field (work email vs email) -> routing logic -> CRM tag -> notification channel (Slack/inbox). Add CSV export note for ops.

Theo Rivers: For social creatives, please include light copy overlays for each tile and one GIF micro-animation (tile flip) if feasible.

Riley (design-ops): Will attempt GIF micro-animation as optional deliverable. Plan: 48-hour first comps (PNG mockups + Figma link) then iterate after copy + legal signoff.

Priya Menon: I'll finalize alt text and localization strings by EOD (EN/FR/DE). Also prepping short form copy for gated vs ungated CTAs.

Asha Patel: Thanks team. When you drop the Figma frames, ping this thread and I'll route to webinar partner for final schedule. :raised_hands:

Riley (design-ops): Dropping first frames now — see Figma. I'll add comments for accessibility copy and provide downloadable assets (PNG, SVG, PPTX).

Theo Rivers: Awesome — looking for the 2 headline variants in the hero slides.

Legal Bot: I'll review the final hero and gated copy once frames are in Figma. Please @Legal Bot in Figma comments for faster turnaround.

Riley (design-ops): Will do. TL;DR checklist I'll attach in Figma: hero (1920x1080), tiles (1080x1080 + 1200x628), social assets, routing matrix slide, GIF optional, alt text + localization files, export package (PNG/SVG/PPTX).

Asha Patel: Solid. Closing loop — deliverables owner: @Riley; copy owner: @Priya; legal: @Legal Bot; comms/Asha will approve final.

Priya Menon: On it — will post final copy in this thread when ready.

Riley (design-ops): Thanks — ping me when copy's in. :thumbsup:
